descriptionMarkdown:
Early game Vulcanus starter base.

Designed to be modular and for bringing few/minimal starting items to Vulcanus.

Designed to create the first 1k science for cliff explosives and coal liquefaction and to build another base afterwards. 

Designed for 90spm and according rocket lauches

Should fit into starting area.
